newsitem.title: USA: Stratasys stock plunges on sales warning.
newsitem.headline: Stratasys stock plunges on sales warning.

text.p: The stock of Stratasys Inc. lost more than 25 percent of its value Monday after the maker of rapid prototyping systems said its second-quarter revenues would fall short of analysts' estimates.
Stratasys fell $5.75 to $16 on the Nasdaq market.
The Eden Prairie, Minn.-based firm said it expects to post a drop in revenues because of manufacturing constraints, the strong dollar and delays in some domestic sales.
However, it said it still expects revenues for the quarter to reach a record high and show a significant improvement from the first quarter's $5.2 million.
Analysts said the company will likely make up the revenue shortfall in the third quarter.
"We feel the stock is substantially oversold," said Martin Meyerson, chairman of investment bankers M.H. Meyerson & Co. "They'll probably make it up next month."
Stratasys makes rapid prototyping devices for the automotive and aerospace industries.
